statements.impact_statement: Alpine 3.24 fixed this CVE in musl 1.2.6-r3 (aports 3.24-stable main/musl/APKBUILD secfixes 1.2.6-r3, CVE-2026-107891.patch; security.alpinelinux.org lists 3.24-main fixed in 1.2.6-r3). Docker Scout applies the edge fix version 1.2.6-r6 to 3.24. Covers only this exact musl build; any other version is scanned normally.
